metadata.description: The skills catalog of xlsft`s harness: a curated list in which every license has been read, and every external entry is pinned by commit.

plugins.name: algorithmic-art
plugins.description: Generative art in p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameters. Origin: anthropics/skills (Apache-2.0), unmodified, pinned by commit; no affiliation or endorsement.

catalog.note: The upstream viewer template is styled with its vendor's brand colors and fonts (no logo), and the skill tells the model to keep them.

plugins.name: canvas-design

catalog.note: Fonts carry SIL OFL files, listed here. At this commit IBMPlexSerif-* and InstrumentSerif-* have no license file of their own: IBMPlexMono-OFL.txt names the reserved font name Plex; nothing names Instrument Serif.
